meta.name: ulw-research
meta.description: Runs maximum-saturation research with a cooperating team, claim-graph gating, and a cited, QA'd deliverable. Use when the user explicitly asks for research or a deep investigation, including any 'ulw' research wording.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把你抛出的问题查透,交付带出处和质检的结论
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果面对复杂问题想要得到论证充分的结论
copy.tagline_en: Conduct exhaustive research on any topic and return a cited, QA'd report
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want a deep, verified answer to any hard question

howto.what: 明确要求深度研究时,Claude 会切换为“ulw-research”模式:先自行划定课题范围并写下计划,再组建多名成员的研究团队分头搜索,用辩论和代码验证来检验发现,最后交付每条断言均带引用或验证的文档。
howto.when: 仅当用户明确要求时才触发:例如说出“ulw-research”“ultradebate”等触发词,或用任意语言明确请求做研究、深度调查。普通问答不会触发。

say.text: 用 ulw-research 调查量子计算的商业应用现状,给带引用的报告。
say.note: 会先确认输出格式(默认 PDF+DOCX)再开始研究。

say.text: 发起 hyperdebate:审查这几篇论文的结论,并运行代码验证关键论断。
say.note: 会安排成员辩论并按需执行代码验证。

say.text: 用 /ulw-research 对代码库做一次深度调查,找出这个崩溃的根本原因。
say.note: 会结合代码检索和外部资料给出带引用的分析。

howto.what_en: On explicit deep-research requests, Claude enters ulw-research mode: it scopes the topic, writes a plan, forms a team of researchers, splits searches, debates findings, runs code to verify claims, and delivers a document where each claim is cited or proven.
howto.when_en: Only on explicit user demand: mentioning 'ulw-research'/'ultradebate' etc., any 'ulw' research wording, or an explicit research/deep-investigation request in any language. Normal questions do not trigger it.

say_en.text: Run ulw-research on quantum computing's commercial applications and deliver a cited report.
say_en.note: It will confirm the output format before researching.

say_en.text: Start a hyperdebate review of these papers' conclusions and run code to verify key claims.
say_en.note: Members will debate and code checks will run.

say_en.text: Use /ulw-research to deeply investigate this codebase and find the root cause of the crash.
